folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B316: actual content, source scope and later direction
folds.body:
HS1–HS4, world qualification, future work and library-search limits were fully content-reviewed. Beeton is a prescriptive1861 English manual; the Paston entry is catalogue evidence rather than manuscript prose; Austen's particular fictional settlements do not establish a universal succession law; Bookworm publisher summaries are reading leads rather than volume-level mechanism qualification. No primary book, PDF, manuscript or web page was reopened here.

Preserve staff title/control/agency, actual wages and held stock, teaching access versus competence, hospitality versus ownership and personally transferable belongings versus landlord/family property. The willing-staff model describes the original H5.8 fixture, not all possible service institutions or canon worlds. A title, legal entitlement, custody, a contested claim and an actual settled transfer can differ. Death does not automatically convey people, contracts, a rented room or every household fixture; the actual source/era arrangement may carry particular rights and obligations.

The zero-configured-file query and86-candidate search with three parse warnings are dated searched-store observations, not present absence or a reason to download duplicates. Current library/source owners govern any future acquisition. H5.8's original balances and native-time assertions remain attributed implementation evidence, not fresh runtime verification. The subsequent source or supply options are proposals with relevant world/consumer scope, and do not restart Frontier depth, add generic hunger or dispatch inheritance work by this review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B316: actual content, source scope and later direction
folds.body:
All acquisition/hands-on limits, six Alterhistorian stages, Factory phases, automation/clock/routing/final-consumer sections, P6–P10 and preservation checks were content-reviewed. This supporting report is added to reconciliation intake because its actual body was read; no source corpus, extraction or linked follow-up inherits that review. The26resources/14machines/25recipe-display definitions/40research entries and269 extracted functions are that lane's output denominators, not proof every behavior was semantically reviewed. Eight source/shipped correspondences are narrower than a byte-identical build or full late-game playthrough.

Retain the concrete distinctions: throughput versus buffer capacity versus pipe rate versus yield; partial prepayment versus full affordability; research visibility versus all executable requirements; a recipe identifier versus operational arrays. The Factory ritual's actual controller-owned accumulation differs from the displayed recipe and is not per-machine merely because multiple machines exist. Its700-gem lower bound omits other buildings/research and is not a completion-time measurement. Old coefficient-bearing IDs should stay stable while the actual definition remains authoritative for behavior. Shared project contributions need explicit custody and settlement rather than duplicate per-machine grants.

A catalytic throughput multiplier that also scales material input is not free yield. A drain outside successful output may continue while blocked. Full coproduct slots can block a wanted product. Fixed ordered splitters differ from equal allocation or a rotating preference; old source's tiny-stack cleanup and wall-clock force term prevent a simplistic constant-ratio or partition-invariance conclusion. Source observations are neither tested present runtime behavior nor recommended defects/policies for this project. Reconfiguration that discards a machine instance is specifically not adopted as a custody-preserving move.

The reported50-machine cap,40% bank conversion,10× total speed and altered post-ending rate are donor-specific inspected rules, not accepted limits or time policy here. Likewise, a final item/ending in a factory game does not prove a living character's immortality. P6–P10 preserve useful gear provisioning, household reserve, supported ritual infrastructure, actual workers and bounded conditional control over real capabilities. Current AD51/AD52 allow a first useful connected consumer and routine compression without an all-world logistics/circuit engine. No further browser grinding is required by this old source-directed task; no new source checkout, account, private save, executable, gameplay or world priority was touched by this local review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B316: actual content, source scope and later direction
folds.body:
All35 comparison cases, sixteen OGR patterns, eight mapping families, P1/P2 examples and P3–P7 ranked suggestions were content-reviewed in three untruncated ranges. The closing historical phrase sixteen GR patterns refers to the renamed OGR family, not registered generation rules. Dedicated dossiers, source traces, published interfaces, developer claims, MEMORY and UNKNOWN retain their actual evidence level. Individual complaints are examples, not prevalence or current balance; contradictory player experiences remain attributed rather than averaged into one rule. No linked page, PDF/manual, video, source trace or game was read or run anew here.

Preserve distinct operations: a surviving retired person, an heir, a retold legacy snapshot, one protagonist's repeated attempt, a reset with retained information, a dead-record adversary, a mindless recording, a visiting player, a ghost and an independent copy. A run or menu boundary settles none of these by itself. Relationship-shaped carriers and actual ownership matter more than a generic retained-XP label. Legacy recruitment does not automatically resume chronological family ages; a saved old draft is not every live individual's present state. MEMORY-based claims that a game lacks persistent previous characters remain unverified within this report, rather than becoming source-wide negatives.

OGR10–OGR14's useful role structure is an actual service/job, staff/participants with means, a named observer and caused exposure/response. A criminal association, dependent captive, demon body, frightening title or occult scholarship does not fix the player's intent. A label should not advertise absent actions. Neither opposition nor compensation for a strong trait must appear for balance alone. Current AD52 qualifies repeated manual scheme renewals and routine upkeep, while legitimate long play, progression and source-supported difficult consequences remain available. No broad ban on a harsh mode or automatic source-world imperviousness is adopted from this comparative friction list.

The old one-realm/one-prestige constraint, one-realm build ordering and1366target are retired or superseded by current scope/UI owners. P4's ordinary successor and P7's full start-page draft remain options, not prerequisites before other selves or a deferred launch redesign. Later directPLAY restoration governs launch. Presets, coherent independent axes, stable admitted choices and optional detail can still serve a selected future route without silently rerolling committed identity. RX's warning about restart farming is not a new anti-cheat policy under AD22; any actual resource duplication must follow the world's declared operation and save integrity.

Continuity offers should explain materially known consequences and uncertainty without exposing sealed truths or pretending a pre-start player's visible choices are already character memories. None filters a selected experience rather than deleting source inhabitants. Optional off-screen change still needs the actual life/world clock and supported actor policy. A freely acting trace requires an actual agency mechanism; a real person may still be frozen or summarized by policy. Current AD42 leaves generic human review optional. No scheme, ghost, successor, start, save or identity law was implemented, no external entitlement or service availability checked, and paused source worlds were not resumed by this review.
